notes: No restaurant table by state or country appears in the FY2025 10-K (nor in the FY2024, FY2023, FY2022 and FY2019 10-Ks checked earlier): Item 2 gives only the total (4,042 restaurants owned and operated) and Item 1 splits them into 3,938 U.S. and 104 international company-owned restaurants, plus 14 international partner-operated restaurants (not recorded, as they are not company-owned). So usStates is null. Employees at Dec 31, 2025: 127,116 in the U.S. and 3,185 internationally, a region the filing itself defines as Canada, France, Germany and the United Kingdom (130,301 in total, plus 1,233 contract workers). The 104 international restaurants are not assigned to countries in the filing, so that region's countries list is null. Rows from different sentences of the 10-K are kept as separate rows, so the U.S. appears twice (restaurants, employees) with different metric keys.
